nvitk.cli.transform
===================

.. py:module:: nvitk.cli.transform

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   ``nvitk-transform`` CLI — geometric transforms.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: main() -> None

   Geometric transform tools.


.. py:function:: cmd_resample(input_path, output_path, reference, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, order)

   Resample a volume onto the grid of a reference image.


.. py:function:: cmd_isotropy(input_path, output_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run)

   Resample a volume to isotropic voxel spacing.


.. py:function:: cmd_rotate(input_path, output_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, angle, axis, order, reshape)

   Rotate a 2D/3D volume around a spatial axis.


.. py:function:: cmd_swap_axes(input_path, output_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, axis0, axis1, perm_order)

   Swap two axes, or apply a full axis permutation with --order.


.. py:function:: cmd_oblique(input_path, output_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, point, normal)

   Sample an oblique 2D slice through a volume defined by a point and normal vector.
